gold: Carcinoma erysipelatoides arising from triple-negative breast cancer

selector.why: The presence of multiple emboli of carcinoma cells in dermal and subcutaneous lymphatic vessels strongly supports Cutaneous Metastasis.

support_spans: A well-demarcated, warm, erythematous plaque, 15 × 12 cm, was seen over the right side of the anterior chest wall around her operation scar
Scattered within the erythema were multiple palpable small nodules
Multiple emboli of carcinoma cells in dermal and subcutaneous lymphatic vessels
contradict_spans: The lesion did not respond to initial topical treatments
